name: Drowsiness Detection
description: A safety co-pilot for cabs and monitoring posts: catches eye closure, blink patterns and yawns as fatigue sets in — and the moment drowsiness appears, an alert with a live snapshot lands on your phone, stopping incidents before they happen.
description_zh: 驾驶舱和值守岗位的“安全副驾”：实时捕捉闭眼、频繁眨眼与打哈欠等疲劳征兆，困倦一旦出现，告警和现场快照即刻推送到手机，把风险拦在事故之前。
author: Seeed Studio
